_comment_model: LLM model configuration — used for the main agent and chart generation
_comment_database: Path to the SQLite database file — relative to project root or absolute path
_comment_session: Session management — 'file' for local FileSessionManager, 'agentcore' for AWS AgentCore Memory
_comment_storage: Storage paths for threads (history JSON) and charts (PNG files) — relative to project root or absolute
_comment_display: Query result display limits, thread title generation, and sample questions count
_comment_cleanup: TTL in days — sessions, threads, and charts older than this are auto-deleted on server startup
_comment_pricing: Per-token pricing for cost estimation (USD) — update when model pricing changes
_comment_chart: Chart generation settings — colors, DPI, timeouts, minimum data requirements
_comment_server: FastAPI server settings — host, port, and allowed CORS origins. FRONTEND_PORT is for reference/start scripts.
